name: 23 New Inn
questions: How big is the site and the rear garden (m² or acres), and can you send a site map showing the boundaries and the side/rear access? Is the access shared with neighbours?
What heating system does the house have and how old is the boiler? Can you share the BER advisory report with the kWh/m²/yr figure for the C2?
Is New Inn taken in charge by Meath County Council, or is there a management company and an annual fee?
How much do you hear the Sligo/Longford trains from the house, 160 m from Enfield station, and do you know when work starts on the 72-home scheme permitted about 700 m away?
Has the house ever been tested for radon, and has the site or estate ever flooded (the Royal Canal and the Blackwater are close by)?

ai.why: Three ground-floor bedrooms (two en suite), a station 160 m away and walkable schools, at €465k. But it's an estate plot in the village centre with no land for two vizslas, needs modernising, and a children's ED is 40–50 minutes away.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but a lived-in village house.

water.detail: Mains likely; not stated, but a village-centre estate in Enfield.

sewer.detail: Mains sewer likely; not stated, but a village-centre estate.

internet.detail: Full fibre likely: not in the listing, but BuyerIQ shows '104 Mb full fibre' at this address. Confirm the provider by Eircode.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Bedrooms 1–3 are on the ground floor (3.53 × 2.74 m, 3.53 × 2.98 m and 3.71 × 2.92 m), two with en suites; no floor plan seen yet.

bedsNote: 3 bedrooms on the ground floor (2 en suite), 2 very large bedrooms upstairs; integrated garage (6.68 × 2.90 m) could convert
tagline: A five-bed detached dormer needing modernisation, with three bedrooms downstairs, in a small estate in the centre of Enfield, 160 m from the station.

pros.text: Three ground-floor bedrooms, two en suite
pros.detail: Bedrooms 1–3 (up to 3.71 × 2.92 m) are downstairs, and Bedrooms 2 and 3 have en suites (about 1.85 × 1.6 m): a ready-made suite for Gabor's parents.
Enfield station, Maynooth/Sligo line: seven Sligo intercity trains each weekday (07:49–19:41) reach Connolly in 46–64 minutes, plus Longford commuter services (count to confirm).
€465,000, about €35k under the €500k line; stamp duty about €4,650, leaving room for upgrades.
St Mary's Primary (mixed, 570 pupils) is 300 m away and Enfield Community College (mixed, 532 pupils) 220 m, both walkable for the boys.

pros.text: Size inside the target, with a garage to convert
pros.detail: 144 m² (1,550 sq ft), plus a 6.68 × 2.90 m (about 19 m²) integrated garage the listing calls 'ideal for conversion'.
BuyerIQ shows 104 Mb full fibre; mains services are likely in the village centre.

pros.text: Private rear garden, wide side access
pros.detail: Listing: 'large front garden', 'wide side/rear access', a block-built shed, and a rear garden 'not overlooked to the rear'.
A five-bed by a commuter station in a growing Meath village should let readily when the family is away.

cons.detail: An estate plot: the site size isn't stated, and a 'large' garden in a small estate will be a fraction of an acre, far short of the ~1 acre wanted for two vizslas.

cons.text: Small estate in the village centre
cons.detail: Neighbours on both sides in a small estate 'right in the village centre'; good for walking to everything, but not the space around the house Gabor wants. Not checked from above yet.
Naas and Connolly are 16+ only; the nearest EDs that take children are Regional Hospital Mullingar (about 50 km) and CHI Temple Street or Tallaght in Dublin (about 40–45 km).
The listing says it 'would benefit from some modernisation/upgrading'; C2 is 175–200 kWh/m²/yr (exact figure not shown). Insulation, heating, kitchen and baths: a rough €40–80k.
Enfield Community College doesn't appear in the Meath feeder-school roundups; Coláiste Clavin, Longwood, swung from 96% (2024) to 54% (2025); Maynooth Post Primary is about 17 km away.
The Sligo line runs 160 m away and the house is in the village centre; ask about train noise and traffic.
BuyerIQ lists 10 planning applications within 1 km, including a permitted 72-home scheme about 680 m away.
The listing doesn't state the heating system; BuyerIQ's flood and radon results are behind its paid report.
